words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 请问你在哪里？(Qǐngwèn nǐ zài nǎlǐ?) — Excuse me, where are you?
我想去中国旅游。(Wǒ xiǎng qù Zhōngguó lǚyóu.) — I want to travel to China.
北京是中国的首都。(Běijīng shì Zhōngguó de shǒudū.) — Beijing is the capital of China.
我们的学校环境很优美。(Wǒmen de xuéxiào huánjìng hěn yōuměi.) — Our school environment is very beautiful.
医院离这里只有五百米。(Yīyuàn lí zhèlǐ zhǐyǒu wǔbǎi mǐ.) — The hospital is only 500 meters away from here.
下午我去机场接朋友。(Xiàwǔ wǒ qù jīchǎng jiē péngyou.) — I am going to the airport this afternoon to pick up a friend.
我们在火车站门口集合。(Wǒmen zài huǒchēzhàn ménkǒu jíhé.) — We will meet at the train station entrance.
坐地铁比开车更快。(Zuò dìtiě bǐ kāichē gèng kuài.) — Taking the subway is faster than driving.
下雨天比较难打出租车。(Xiàyǔ tiān bǐjiào nán dǎ chūzūchē.) — It is harder to hail a taxi on rainy days.
你可以坐一路公共汽车去市中心。(Nǐ kěyǐ zuò yī lù gōnggòng qìchē qù shìzhōngxīn.) — You can take bus route 1 to downtown.
飞机两个小时后起飞。(Fēijī liǎng gè xiǎoshí hòu qǐfēi.) — The airplane takes off in two hours.
路上的车很多，交通有点堵。(Lù shang de chē hěn duō, jiāotōng yǒudiǎn dǔ.) — There are many cars on the road, traffic is a bit jammed.

words.English Meaning: to sit / to ride / to take (a vehicle)
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 请坐，不要客气。(Qǐng zuò, bú yào kèqi.) — Please sit, don't stand on ceremony.

words.English Meaning: to drive / to open / to start
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 他每天开车去上班。(Tā měitiān kāichē qù shàngbān.) — He drives to work every day.

words.English Meaning: up / above / on top / to get on
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 书在桌子上。(Shū zài zhuōzi shang.) — The book is on the table.

words.English Meaning: down / below / under / to get off
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 小猫藏在椅子下面。(Xiǎomāo cáng zài yǐzi xiàmian.) — The kitten is hiding under the chair.
学校前面有一家书店。(Xuéxiào qiánmian yǒu yì jiā shūdiàn.) — There is a bookstore in front of the school.
医院后面是一个大花园。(Yīyuàn hòumian shì yí gè dà huāyuán.) — Behind the hospital is a large garden.
向左拐就是地铁站。(Xiàng zuǒ guǎi jiù shì dìtiězhàn.) — Turn left and that's the subway station.
你的右边是谁？(Nǐ de yòubian shì shéi?) — Who is on your right side?
包里有两支笔和一本笔记本。(Bāo lǐ yǒu liǎng zhī bǐ hé yì běn bǐjìběn.) — There are two pens and a notebook inside the bag.
请问去博物馆怎么走这条路？(Qǐngwèn qù bówùguǎn zěnme zǒu zhè tiáo lù?) — Excuse me, how do I take this road to the museum?
从我家到公司不算太远。(Cóng wǒ jiā dào gōngsī bú suàn tài yuǎn.) — From my home to the company is not too far.
这家咖啡馆离学校很近。(Zhè jiā kāfēiguǎn lí xuéxiào hěn jìn.) — This café is very close to school.
请问到天安门广场怎么走？(Qǐngwèn dào Tiān'ānmén Guǎngchǎng zěnme zǒu?) — Excuse me, how do I get to Tiananmen Square?
